Section numbers in the reasons refer to the file the row names, not to this page. Speaking-rate rows are owned by [`pacing-cadence-wpm.md`](phase-04-audio-narration/pacing-cadence-wpm.md).

**What each status means.** RESOLVED: settled by the two card bodies and the package's rules, with the edit named in the reason. ALREADY: an earlier round settled it. SAFETY: a tier 0 defect, repaired on sight. OPEN: the cards and rules do not settle it; it waits for the owner. HERITAGE: it turns on a historical fact that only a cited source may settle; it waits for the owner. HEADER and NOTE: labels and the register's own notes.
